purpose: The endpoint's blocking gate is a whole-model artifact that passes the whole-model gates. This states exactly what that costs, so the next window is planned rather than discovered.

the_representation.arm: activation-aware projection: W restricted to the top-k directions of the layer's REAL captured activation covariance
the_representation.measured: cosine 0.755 at 0.167 BPW and 0.793 at 0.667 BPW on real routed experts, against a real-activation null of 0.651
the_representation.replication: 12/12 routed experts beat the null at 0.167 BPW; raw-weight low-rank 0/12 at four times the rate
the_representation.basis_source: the 33 retained teacher capsules, 80 GB of real captured activations
the_representation.basis_transfer: measured: a neighbouring layer's basis is as good or better, and degrades gently to at least four layers away, so 33 capsules cover 78 layers

whole_model_cost_model.formula: rank k over an [out,in] tensor costs (out*k + in*k)*16 bits, plus the stored basis, plus headers and index
whole_model_cost_model.caveat: these are projections from measured per-organ costs, not a packed artifact. Bases, headers and the index are counted in the arm's BPW as measured; whole-model overheads (manifest, per-shard framing) are not yet included and will raise the figure.

phase_1_measurement.cost: ~1.7 h of fetch at the measured 2.0 Gbit/s, overlapped with measurement

phase_2_allocation.objective: maximise preserved function at a whole-model BPW target, driven by functional preservation and never by reconstruction error

phase_3_packing.cost: prior PASS3 took ~13 h under a different program; this one is cheaper per tensor (an eigendecomposition and two matmuls) but the figure is unmeasured

execution_plan.hard_constraint: 141 GiB free against a 1.507 TB parent. Streaming with eviction is mandatory; the parent is never resident.

the_gates_that_decide.order: cheapest first, so a failure costs the least
the_gates_that_decide.G_math: tokens [17, 488, 220, 17, 284] -- one forward pass. Math-Preserve fails this and it would have caught it in minutes.
the_gates_that_decide.G_live: prompt-dependent generation: two unrelated prompts must not produce identical output
the_gates_that_decide.G_parity: numpy oracle over the same container and codec versus Rust/Metal, argmax and top-5 in exact order. A failure here implicates the runtime and stops everything.
the_gates_that_decide.G_cascade: composed end to end, not judged per layer
the_gates_that_decide.G_halo: the frozen 26-task corpus, only after the cheap gates pass
the_gates_that_decide.law: reconstruction error cannot promote, at any stage

what_would_make_this_Math_Preserve_v2: an artifact that passes G_math and G_live, whose hash is then bound into odyssey/launch/SUBSTRATE_CAPABILITY.json with capability_verdict APPROVED. No artifact currently holds that verdict, and the current Math-Preserve is REFUSED by hash.
honest_uncertainty: A per-organ cosine of 0.79 against a 0.651 null is a real margin, not an overwhelming one. Whether it composes across 78 layers into coherent generation is exactly what G_cascade and G_live exist to answer, and no window measurement can predict it.
Only routed experts and four non-expert organs were measured. Attention, norms and the head under real activations are unmeasured.
Distant basis transfer (layer 10's basis onto a layer-60 expert) is untested; the program should prefer the nearest donor and record which it used.
